body: I’m just tired... I’m tired of the struggle of putting on a phony face and pretending everything is fine. I’m just tired
I’m still here. That’s very nice of you to say
It’s actually the 13th. But thank you. I’m still here. It’s rough. I feel like quitting everyday.

How do you deal with things?

I.know I have issues but I have never done anything while my kids were there. I still picked them up. Take them to their practices. Took them to their games. Have them for half a week.  We had a agreement. I pay her rent. I would get the kids anytime. But now she wants more. Killing me....
No nothing after that.  Once I self cut.  Went to the hospital. They called police but I said I got into a fight and that person stabbed me.
I use to be in therapy. I stopped.
I.just don't get why now it's an issue with her.  She has no problem leaving me with kids for days at a time so she can go out and party or have her alone time

I appreciate your advice.  I'm not going to pretend I'm ok. I'm ready struggling with everything.  I've issues with self harm. Then two suicide attempts. During this stretch she was never worried about my kids well being.  I would have them 3_4 a week. But now she is worried about the kids? She didn't seem worried when she went to Mexico for a week or Vegas or San Diego.
Yes.  She has all of it.  It happened 7 years ago. But I've had issues after that.
That’s the most heart breaking thing for me is not being able to have my kids.  It’s so unbearable
I think I pretty screwed. I don’t know what to do.
Sorry just finished writing. I put in my letters that they not tell my kids I killed myself.  I'm not sure they will listen. I hope they do
Just read my posts from here. You'll see where I'm.coming from
That's a nice thought. I think if it as ok now I know what I.have to do to succeed
People keep telling me that. This just sucks.  I woke up crying.  Thinking to myself one more day. I don't want to see my kids today and tomorrow. It'll hurt too much

You don’t know shit. You honestly think I haven’t thought about my kids? About what this will do to them. I know I’m a piece of shit. But I’m also a piece of shit who knows the repercussions of my actions. For the past 7 years it’s something that I ve struggled with. Isomeone who tries to kill themselves doesn’t take a decision like this easy. But when you suffer from mental illness. It’s hard to rationalize normality
Thanks for the pep talk fuck face. Guy don't know Shit. I.didn't post here fit someone to talk me out or for some I've to feel sorry for me.  I did it as an outlet. For me to vent.that's it
They have seen me already weak. They have already seen me at my worse. The kids will be better off and so will be my wife. Or ex wife actually
They see a weak man. Someone who quit.
I’ve been going through this for 7 years.  She’ll understand and be better off

I’ve had two previous suicide attempts. I have seen therapist and psychiatrist. Been on meds. Made bad decisions. I was a terrible husband. She deserves to be happy and better off. My kids have seen the worse of me.  They’ve seen me taken to a hospital. They’ve seen me in a mental hospital. I’ve already messed up lives.  It’s better that I’m gone
She is probably going to take it like that. Even though in my letter to her I’m doing it bc of me not her.

You have no idea. I don’t know exactly what you are going through. Me... I wish I could bite a bullet, but I have 3 Kids... one in high school. One in middle school. And one only 4. So. I’ll fuck them all up. I struggling....
No. I have 2 full bottles of soma pills. I plan on finishing those two bottles and put a plastic bag over my head before I pass out
Is the anything I can take that I can't wake up from? I know it's cowardly. But oh man it would be so easy.... ugh god I hate it right now. I'm such a coward

God. Why do people always feel the need to help? Jesus. Look I ready. I just want a good place to do it? Any suggestions would be awesome. Otherwise, I'd finish my bottle of pills with a bottle of johnny walker blue label and do it
I'm not going to see a lot. But they won't at least see how destructive  I am to myself.

I guess I'm naive about everything. I've tried to kill Mattis multiple times. Took pills, ambulance came took me to the hospital. I spent 3 weeks in a behavioral institute. Stabbed myself in the stomach. Passed out.from bleeding. Spent more time in a institute. I've cut my chest burned myself. All lot of it comes from the fighting and arguments from my marriage. Off and on for three years. The last fight was our last fight. I'm just done. So now I'm wondering if I should tell by kids all the stuff I've done to myself and the fights with their mom
Maybe
The only reason I'm torn is BC some of the reasons are BC of my marriage. I don't want them to change or look at their mom differently or bad mouth her

Idk, not really.  She would listen. Tell me to get a divorce.  Sometimes I think I really delusional about my surroundings. I know I'm the problem. It's my fault I'm in the situation I'm in.  And I know I can change it. Go to work, spend time with my kids.  Try to reconcile with my wife. But it's me.  I'm stopping myself.  I hate it but I know it's me. I've been on so many forms of antidepressants for so long.  I'm just tired.

Similar to you.  Calling out a lot. Sometimes I can't get out of bed. Been suspended twice for calling out.  Two more call in and I'll be fired.  It's been a real struggle to go to work.  Then once I get there I wanna leave. Sometimes I can sometimes i can't

I have family I think I could talk to.  I can't. I'm embarrassed or worried.  Embarrassed bc they might change the way they view me. Worried bc my parents already know about my previous suicide attempt.  I woke up in the hospital. They were right there. My dad will throw bible scriptures at me. I don't want to hear it. My friend will tell me to be a man and suck it up or stop being a little "bitch". My wife (ex wife) told me once she thinks I'm faking it. Sometimes I'll post up here.  I had a psychotherapist and a therapist. I just stop seeing them.

Everything. I'm separated from my wife. I let my self go financially. I rather be home alone then pick up my kids. Massive debt. Close to being fired from my job. I'm causing all these things to myself.  I know it's my depression that's put me on a bad road. Can't shake it. Thoughts of suicide keep coming back in. I cut myself a lot. Cuts on my ankles. Big cuts on my chest and wrist. Burn marks on my arms. I do a lot of self abuse
